steps.sql: DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'{"pad":['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535)+N'0],"v":[]}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM OPENJSON(@j);
DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'{"pad":['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535)+N'0],"v":[]}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM OPENJSON(@j,'$.pad');
DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'{"pad":['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535)+N'0],"v":[]}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(@j) WITH(v int '$.pad[0]');

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'{"pad":['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535)+N'0],"v":[]}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(v) AS bytes FROM OPENJSON(@j) WITH(v nvarchar(max) '$.pad' AS JSON);
